component.name: Mister Download Manager
component.summary: Multi-connection download manager with BitTorrent, written in Rust

description.p: This is a community package of Mister Download Manager, maintained independently and unaffiliated with the Mister Download Manager project. It repackages the official upstream Linux build (the .tar.gz release) unmodified.

Mister Download Manager (MDM) is a download manager written from scratch in Rust, with a classic download-manager window, queues and a scheduler. It splits each download over several connections, resumes interrupted transfers, and keeps its list across restarts.

ul.li: HTTP, HTTPS and FTP downloads over multiple connections, with speed limits and queues.
Link grabber, checksum verification and archive extraction.
Several themes, light and dark, and many interface languages.

description.p: Browser integration: the browser extension's Native Messaging connection is not available under Flatpak, because a host browser cannot start MDM's helper program inside the sandbox. Add downloads with Add URL, or by opening magnet links and .torrent files.

Permissions: this package keeps a tight sandbox by default: display, GPU, network, a tray icon and your Downloads folder. Saving to any other folder goes through the desktop's file chooser. To grant a folder permanently, run flatpak override --user --filesystem=~/Media com.misterdownloadmanager.MisterDownloadManager, substituting your own path; --filesystem=home grants the whole home directory.
The in-app updater and the "start with the session" setting do not apply here: updates arrive through Flatpak, and the autostart entry the app writes stays inside the sandbox.
